description: Swap profile cards and wave at CardputerZeros close by

store.summary: Swap profile cards with Cardputers you pass, and wave at them
store.description:
Your CardputerZero carries a small profile card: a nickname, a colour, a status line and a 16x16 avatar you draw on the keyboard. Walk past anyone else running Nearby and you swap cards automatically, even with the app closed and the Cardputer in your pocket.

Around shows who is in range right now, with signal bars. Met is your collection of everyone you have swapped with. Pick someone and wave at them with a short message; their Cardputer beeps and shows it.

Everything is sent in the open over Bluetooth LE: anyone nearby running Nearby can read your card and waves. The radio address changes every 15 minutes, and a listen-only switch hides you completely. Mute anyone who spams.

Keys: 1-4 tabs, F/X up and down, Z/C left and right, Enter to wave or edit, M to mute, Esc to leave. The background service runs as your user with one Bluetooth permission, not as root. Source code is linked below.
